zh.site.title: randomArt可视化创意编程
zh.about.title: 简介
zh.about.p1: randomArt可视化创意编程是基于localStorage存储的纯前端工具，无须后端。
zh.about.p2: 首页随机加载运行p5.js脚本，编写脚本后提交脚本点击“预览”即可运行该脚本或在侧边栏中选择脚本名运行脚本，再点击其它导航项会回到随机状态。
zh.about.p3: AI助手支持ChatGPT / Gemini / DeepSeek流式输出，也支持自定义OpenAI兼容模型。每个模型可单独设置API Key与系统提示词，支持Markdown/JSON双格式导出，并可从JSON文件导入对话继续使用。JSON导出含结构化响应元数据（finish_reason / usage / tool_calls等）。
zh.about.p4: 使用CodeMirror实现代码高亮，支持亮色/暗色主题。
zh.about.p5: 所有脚本均可导出为zip包，也可单独下载为HTML。

en.site.title: randomArt Visual Creative Coding
en.about.title: About
en.about.p1: randomArt Visual Creative Coding is a pure frontend tool using localStorage; no backend required.
en.about.p2: The home page randomly runs a p5.js sketch. After writing a script, click Preview to run it, or select it from the sidebar. Switching to another tab returns to random mode.
en.about.p3: The AI assistant supports ChatGPT / Gemini / DeepSeek streaming, plus custom OpenAI-compatible models. Each model has its own API key and system prompt. Supports Markdown / JSON export and JSON import. The JSON export includes structured metadata (finish_reason / usage / tool_calls, etc.).
en.about.p4: CodeMirror provides syntax highlighting with light/dark themes.
en.about.p5: All scripts can be exported as a ZIP package, or downloaded individually as HTML.
